items.name: Extra Health
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Getting burst when you go in. Sell it for Unstoppable.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-11,200 (levels 1-18). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Riposte T3. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Hunter's Aura, vitality 4.8k at Healing Booster. Ultimate (Itani Lo Sahn) is available from Hunter's Aura.

items.name: Melee Lifesteal
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Healing Booster, 8800 souls (~8.8 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Melee Charge
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Hunter's Aura completes 4,000 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Hunter's Aura completes 4.8k weapon in 4000 souls (~4.0 min), 2 purchases
items.legacy_note: Once Riposte has its longer stun, heavy melee right after it.

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Healing Booster, 6400 souls (~6.4 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Hunter's Aura
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (1,600 to 4,800 invested): bonus 12 to 46% weapon damage.

items.name: Lifestrike
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Healing Booster completes 800 souls on. Upgrade of Melee Lifesteal (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.
items.why: imminent: Healing Booster completes 4.8k vitality in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Healing Booster
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (4,000 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Extra Regen (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Close Quarters
items.why: weapon investment only; its 6.4k tier completes at Stalker, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Grit
items.caption: Builds toward the 6.4k vitality tier, which Reactive Barrier completes 800 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Reactive Barrier completes 6.4k vitality in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 11,200-27,200 (levels 18-29). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Itani Lo Sahn T3.

items.name: Reactive Barrier
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 5,600 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.

items.name: Stalker
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 5,600 to 7,200 invested: bonus 46 to 54% weapon damage.

items.name: Point Blank
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 7,200 to 9,600 invested: bonus 54 to 62% weapon damage.

items.name: Berserker
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 9,600 to 12,800 invested: bonus 62 to 74% weapon damage.

items.name: Crushing Fists
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 12,800 to 17,600 invested: bonus 74 to 86% weapon damage.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you. Takes vitality from 6,400 to 9,600 invested: bonus 42 to 46 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Get it earlier if most of their damage is spirit.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 27,200-51,200 (levels 29-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Disengaging Sigil T3, Flawless Advance T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Flawless Advance, perfect damage) grows from 125 to 225.

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 9,600 to 16,000 invested, crossing the 11.2k, 16k tiers: bonus 46 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Phantom Strike
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 16,000 to 22,400 invested: bonus 54 to 60 vitality bonus.

items.name: Indomitable
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: upgrade_of)

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Disengaging Sigil (movement) and Riposte (channelled). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown. Takes vitality from 27,200 to 33,600 invested: bonus 60 to 66 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Get it earlier if stuns keep stopping you before you reach them.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Lifestrike? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Stalker.
sections.desc: Dying after Lifestrike? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Stalker.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Hexes and slows keep you off them.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Grey Talon's charged arrow.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry is melting you up close.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Healbane
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Their healer keeps your target alive.

items.name: Colossus
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Scourge
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (0 to 6,400 invested, crossing the 4.8k, 6.4k tiers): bonus 0 to 45 spirit power. Replaces Spirit Resilience: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Healing Tempo
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Healing Booster for 4,800 more souls: bonus fire rate 0 to 35; tech resist 0 to 10..
